kind_of_thing.quote: Spiders (order Araneae) are air-breathing arthropods that have eight limbs, chelicerae with fangs generally able to inject venom, and spinnerets that extrude silk.

kind_of_animal.quote: Spiders (class Arachnida, order Araneae) are air-breathing arthropods.

extinct.quote: Spiders are found worldwide on every continent except Antarctica, and have become established in nearly every land habitat.
